input.quote: Upon termination or expiration of this Agreement, each party shall otherwise return or destroy any Confidential Information of the other party provided, however, Corio may retain any Confidential Information necessary for Corio to continue supporting it's then-existing Customers.
input.rationale: Transition continuity is well covered and in fact exceeds the preferred position: Section 11.3 and Section 5.3 make our license to serve then-existing Customers and Commerce One's support and maintenance obligations survive termination indefinitely (subject to fee payment), and Section 12 adds a source code escrow. However, the exit provisions contain no data return: Section 11.3 only requires each party to "return or destroy" the other's Confidential Information at Commerce One's election, with no obligation to return data of Corio, its Customers or Software Users held on the MarketSite.net Service, no machine-readable format, no 30-day deadline and no deletion certification. Because the fallback requires a data export within 30 days and the current wording permits outright destruction of our data (walk-away territory), this fails the fallback on a material term. We propose a narrow insert (new Section 11.4) requiring return within 30 days in a machine-readable format, then deletion with written certification, together with the preferred six-month transition assistance at then-current rates; the assistance period can drop to 90 days as a fallback.

ops.text: 11.4 Transition Assistance and Data Return. Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Commerce One shall (a) at Corio's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Commerce One's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Corio's request, return to Corio all data of Corio and its Customers and Software Users in Commerce One's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Corio in writing, except to the extent retention is required by applicable law.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 11.3 preserves our license and Commerce One's post-termination support, but it lets Commerce One destroy our and our Customers' data with no return obligation, format or timeline. We have added a 30-day return of that data in a machine-readable format, followed by deletion and written certification, plus transition assistance at then-current rates; we can accept a 90-day assistance period if that is easier.
proposal.summary: Insert a data-return, deletion-certification and transition-assistance provision in Section 11
